items.raw_excerpt: More than 3.8 million people were members of public libraries in the Netherlands in 2025, a 3% increase over the year before according to new numbers by national statistics office CBS. The number of adult library members rose by 46,000 to nearly 1.4 million. In particular, an increasing number of younger adults, those between the ages of 18 and 30, are joining libraries. In total, 9% of adults are library members. That statistic is dwarfed by the number of children who...
items.summary_en: More than 3.8 million people belonged to a public library in the Netherlands in 2025. That is 3 percent more than the year before. Adult members grew, especially young adults aged 18 to 30.
items.summary_ko: 2025년 네덜란드에서 공공도서관 회원 수가 380만 명을 넘었습니다. 지난해보다 3% 늘어난 수치입니다. 특히 18세에서 30세 사이의 젊은 성인 회원이 크게 늘고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Library membership in the Netherlands tops 3.8 million
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 도서관 회원 380만 명 돌파, 젊은 성인 가입 늘어
items.title_original: Library membership tops 3.8 million as more adults sign up

items.raw_excerpt: The Dutch Food and Safety Authority has announced that it will impose fines on four Irish carriers transporting unweaned calves to the Netherlands.
items.summary_en: The Dutch Food and Safety Authority will fine four Irish carriers. They moved unweaned calves to the Netherlands. The fines follow animal welfare rules for very young calves.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 식품안전당국이 아일랜드 운송업체 네 곳에 벌금을 부과하기로 했다. 이 업체들은 젖을 떼지 못한 송아지를 네덜란드로 수송한 것으로 전해졌다. 어린 송아지 보호 규정을 어긴 데 따른 제재다.
items.title_en: Dutch to Fine Irish Carriers Transporting Unweaned Calves
items.title_ko: 네덜란드, 젖을 떼지 못한 송아지 실어 나른 아일랜드 운송업체에 벌금
items.title_original: Dutch to fine Irish carriers transporting unweaned calves

items.raw_excerpt: Banks in Telangana advise customers to plan ahead and utilize digital services as a nationwide strike may disrupt branch operations.
items.summary_en: Banks in Telangana told customers to plan ahead. They advise using digital services. A nationwide strike may affect branch operations from September 11 to 14.
items.summary_ko: 텔랑가나 주 은행들이 고객에게 미리 계획하라고 안내했다. 디지털 서비스를 이용하라고 권했다. 전국적인 파업으로 9월 11일부터 14일까지 지점 운영이 중단될 수 있다.
items.title_en: Telangana banks urge customers to plan ahead for strike
items.title_ko: 텔랑가나 은행, 파업 대비 미리 계획하라고 안내
items.title_original: Banking services likely to be hit from September 11-14; SLBC advises people to plan ahead, use digital channels

items.raw_excerpt: Yeo Yann Yann has been nominated for best performance, while The Violinist is up for best animated film.
items.summary_en: Yeo Yann Yann was nominated for best performance at the Asia Pacific Screen Awards. The animated film The Violinist was nominated for best animated film. Both are Singaporean works or co-productions.
items.summary_ko: 배우 여우연연(Yeo Yann Yann)이 아시아태평양 스크린 어워드 최우수 연기 부문 후보에 올랐다. 애니메이션 영화 바이올리니스트도 최우수 애니메이션 부문 후보로 선정됐다. 두 작품 모두 싱가포르가 참여한 공동 제작 작품이다.
items.title_en: Singapore actress and animated film nominated for Asia Pacific Screen Awards
items.title_ko: 여우연연과 바이올리니스트, 아시아태평양 스크린 어워드 후보
items.title_original: Asia Pacific Screen Awards 2026 nominees include Yeo Yann Yann, The Violinist and other Singaporean co-productions

items.raw_excerpt: Victoria Mountain says she was in tears when she first saw the state her home had been left in.
items.summary_en: A landlord found her home left in very bad condition by a tenant. She said she was in tears when she first saw the state of the property. This happened in England.
items.summary_ko: 집주인이 세입자가 집을 엉망으로 만들고 간 모습을 보고 눈물을 흘렸다. 처음 집 상태를 봤을 때 눈물이 났다고 말했다. 영국에서 일어난 일이다.
items.title_en: Tenant left my property in a shocking state
items.title_ko: 세입자가 집을 엉망으로 두고 가 충격
items.title_original: 'Tenant left my property in a shocking state'

items.raw_excerpt: Keine Firma käme, wenn im Ausland Aargauerfähnli verteilt würden, sagte SVP-Fraktionschef Pascal Furer im Mai. Der Regierungsrat erklärt nun, worum es geht.
items.summary_en: An SVP politician said that handing out Aargau flags abroad would attract no companies. The cantonal government has now explained what the Greater Zurich Area marketing campaign is actually about. The debate centers on how the region presents itself beyond its borders.
items.summary_ko: 국민당(SVP) 원내대표는 외국에서 아르가우 깃발을 나눠줘도 기업이 오지 않을 거라고 말했다. 주 정부가 취리히 광역권(Greater Zurich Area) 마케팅의 실제 목적을 설명했다. 논쟁의 핵심은 이 지역이 국경 밖에서 어떻게 소개되는지다.
items.title_en: Would Aargau flags really attract no companies? Kanton explains Greater Zurich Area marketing
items.title_ko: 아르가우 깃발로 기업이 온다? 취리히 광역권 마케팅을 둘러싼 논쟁
items.title_original: Dieter Egli zur Greater Zurich Area: «Es geht eben nicht um Aargauerfähnli» - aargauerzeitung.ch

items.raw_excerpt: This French word sounds like you're 'stopping yourself'...
items.summary_en: Today's French word is 'auto-stop', which means hitchhiking. At first it sounds like stopping yourself, but in France it means thumbing a ride from a passing car.
items.summary_ko: 오늘의 프랑스어 단어 '오토스톱'은 히치하이킹을 뜻합니다. 처음에는 스스로를 멈춘다는 뜻처럼 들리지만, 프랑스에서는 손을 들어 지나가는 차에 태워 달라고 하는 행동을 가리킵니다.
items.title_en: French Word of the Day: Auto-stop
items.title_original: French Word of the Day: Auto-stop

items.raw_excerpt: Mario Pérez tiene 23 años, es valenciano y trabaja en la hostelería. Hasta ahí su perfil se parece bastante al de otros miles de jóvenes de la Generación Z...
items.summary_en: Mario is 23 years old, from Valencia, and worked in the hospitality sector. He left the city to open a bar in a tiny village in Cuenca that has only 96 residents. For him, success means not having to leave this small town.
items.summary_ko: 마리오는 23살로 발렌시아 출신이고 호텔·외식 업계에서 일했다. 그는 도시를 떠나 주민 96명뿐인 쿠엥카의 작은 마을에서 바를 열었다. 그에게 성공이란 이 작은 마을을 떠나지 않아도 되는 것이다.
items.title_en: Mario, 23, left Valencia to open a bar in a town of 96 people: 'Success is not having to leave'
items.title_ko: 23살 마리오, 발렌시아 떠나 주민 96명 마을에서 바를 열다: "성공은 떠나지 않아도 되는 것"
items.title_original: Mario, 23 años, dejó Valencia para abrir un bar en un pueblo de Cuenca de 96 vecinos: "El éxito es no tener que irme" - Xataka

items.raw_excerpt: The Viseu International Literary Festival (FLIV) will be held in that city to host national and international authors, with sessions spread throughout the city, exhibitions, concerts, debates, presentations and book launches, the organisation announced.
items.summary_en: The Viseu International Literary Festival (FLIV) will take place in Viseu. It will bring national and international authors to the city. There will be sessions, exhibitions, concerts, debates, presentations, and book launches.
items.summary_ko: 비세우 국제 문학 축제가 비세우에서 열립니다. 국내외 작가들이 이 도시를 찾아옵니다. 발표회, 전시회, 음악회, 토론과 책 출간 행사가 준비되어 있습니다.
items.title_en: A new book festival is coming to Portugal
items.title_original: Portugal will have a new book festival with national and international authors

items.raw_excerpt: Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems said management erred in its assessment and acted “hastily” without fully considering that the graduates had only recently joined the company.
items.summary_en: A Chinese car parts supplier fired 107 new graduates only about a month after they joined. The managers admitted the decision was hasty and wrong. The company paid compensation and punished the managers.
items.summary_ko: 중국 자동차 부품 업체가 입사 약 한 달 만에 신입 졸업생 107명을 해고했던 일을 두고 잘못임을 인정했습니다. 회사는 성급했던 판단이었다며 보상금을 지급하고 관련 관리자들을 징계했습니다.
items.title_en: Chinese car parts firm pays back 107 fired graduates and punishes managers
items.title_ko: 중국 자동차 부품 회사, 입사 한 달 만에 해고된 졸업생 107명에게 보상
items.title_original: Chinese auto supplier compensates 107 graduates fired barely a month into jobs, punishes managers

items.raw_excerpt: Sending children to school in France can be quite a culture shock for foreign parents - from delicious school lunches and impressive after-school care to complaints about a rigid attitude and lack of imagination, here's how readers of The Local view the French system.
items.summary_en: Foreign parents in France share their views on the French school system. They praise the good lunches and strong after-school care. But they also feel the teaching style is rigid and lacks imagination.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에 사는 외국인 부모들이 프랑스 학교 시스템에 대한 생각을 나눕니다. 맛있는 점심과 알찬 방과후 돌봄은 칭찬하지만, 경직된 수업 방식과 상상력 부족은 아쉽다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: How foreign parents see the French school system
items.title_ko: 해외 부모들이 바라본 프랑스 학교 시스템
items.title_original: Great lunches but rigid teaching: How foreign parents view the French school system

items.raw_excerpt: Do you know that feeling when your alarm clock goes off early in the morning and it feels physically painful to get out of bed? The Danes have coined a term for that and we've made it our expression of the day.
items.summary_en: Getting out of bed when the alarm rings early can feel physically painful. The Danes have a funny phrase for that feeling and for waking at a very early hour. 'Klokken lort' describes an absurdly early time in the morning.
items.summary_ko: 새벽에 알람이 울릴 때 침대에서 몸을 일으키기가 몹시 괴로운 경험을 해 본 적이 있을 것이다. 덴마크 사람들은 그런 느낌을 가리키는 재미있는 말을 쓴다. 바로 'klokken lort'로, 터무니없이 이른 새벽 시간을 빗댄 표현이다.
items.title_en: Danish expression of the day: klokken lort
items.title_original: Danish expression of the day: klokken lort

items.raw_excerpt: From Westbahnhof to the Riesenrad, fans are still retracing the Vienna locations made famous by Before Sunrise. The Local spoke to the Vienna Tourist Board about the film’s enduring appeal and the places where visitors can step into Jesse and Céline’s story.
items.summary_en: Fans are still visiting the Vienna locations made famous by the film Before Sunrise. The Vienna Tourist Board talks about the film's lasting appeal. Visitors can walk through the places where Jesse and Céline spent their night.
items.summary_ko: 팬들은 영화 '비포 선라이즈'로 유명해진 빈의 장소들을 아직도 찾아다니고 있습니다. 빈 관광청은 이 영화의 꾸준한 인기에 대해 이야기합니다. 방문객들은 제시와 셀린의 이야기가 담긴 장소들을 직접 걸어볼 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Fans retrace Before Sunrise spots in Vienna
items.title_ko: 빈에서 '비포 선라이즈' 촬영지를 따라 걷는 팬들
items.title_original: ‘The magic of the film’: Where to find the Before Sunrise locations in Vienna
